parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the front of the coffee machine used to control power or brewing functions.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main control interface for turning the machine on/off or starting the brewing process.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: A stainless steel container or bowl that holds water or coffee grounds during brewing.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the main vessel for containing liquid or coffee grounds during the brewing process.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached and reattached for cleaning or refilling purposes.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the coffee machine made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other components, houses internal mechanisms, and provides stability to the machine.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
